# smplkit_audit_forwarder (Data Source)

Read a smplkit audit forwarder by id. Header values are returned as `<redacted>`; the real values live only on the audit service side.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "smplkit_audit_forwarder" "splunk_prod" {
  id = "splunk-prod"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) The forwarder key.

### Read-Only

- `configuration` (Attributes) Destination HTTP request configuration. Header values are redacted. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--configuration))
- `created_at` (String) RFC3339 creation timestamp.
- `description` (String) Optional description.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether deliveries are attempted.
- `filter` (String) JSON Logic filter (JSON-encoded).
- `forwarder_type` (String) Destination family.
- `name` (String) Display name.
- `transform` (String) Transform expression.
- `transform_type` (String) Transform engine (currently JSONATA).
- `updated_at` (String) RFC3339 last-modified timestamp.
- `version` (Number) Monotonic version counter.

<a id="nestedatt--configuration"></a>
### Nested Schema for `configuration`

Read-Only:

- `headers` (Attributes List) Headers attached to every outbound request (values redacted). (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--configuration--headers))
- `method` (String) HTTP method.
- `success_status` (String) Required success status.
- `url` (String) Destination URL.

<a id="nestedatt--configuration--headers"></a>
### Nested Schema for `configuration.headers`

Read-Only:

- `name` (String) Header name.
- `value` (String, Sensitive) Header value (always `<redacted>`).
